dedupe_keys.name: new york state retail food stores

description: This data set lists every retail food store licensed by the New York State Department of Agriculture and Markets: supermarkets, grocery and convenience stores, and other food retailers. Each record gives the county, licence number, operation and establishment type, legal and trading names, address, square footage and a georeference. The producer is the department's Division of Food Safety and Inspection, published on the state open data portal. Coverage is statewide at store level, posted annually; the rows read today were updated on 30 September 2025. Data download as CSV or JSON and through the Socrata API without registration, under the portal's terms of use; no licence is named in the metadata. Caveats: it is a snapshot that may not reflect current operations, it does not include restaurants or food banks, and floor area is the only capacity measure. Simulation uses: an inventory of food retail points for exposure of food access to hurricanes, floods and power outages, siting of emergency food distribution, and modelling of household access after disruption. Related records: the USDA Food Access Research Atlas (data-usda-ers-food-access-research-atlas) gives tract-level access indicators.
